name: Canadian Astronomy Data Centre
rights_or_public_access_basis: Records explicitly public in collection metadata
known_limitations: Rights and acknowledgements vary by contributing collection; generic bulk ingestion is unsafe

name: ESO Science Archive
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only ObsCore rows with a non-null past obs_release_date; ESO archive data are CC BY 4.0 with programme/DOI acknowledgment requirements
known_limitations: Authenticated TAP can expose PI-authorized proprietary metadata; this adapter sends no credentials, repeats the release-date check locally, and does not download product bytes

name: Gemini Observatory Archive
rights_or_public_access_basis: Non-proprietary data are world-public after the provider release date
known_limitations: Science data usually have a 12-month proprietary period; public-date checks are mandatory

name: HEASARC
rights_or_public_access_basis: Past-release Swift, Chandra, XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, NICER, and XRISM master-table rows that satisfy a mission-specific availability contract
known_limitations: Visible master-table rows can still be proprietary or not yet archive-ready; future/blank release dates are excluded, XMM additionally requires data_in_heasarc=Y, and NICER requires VALIDATED

name: IVOA-compatible services
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only rows explicitly public at the configured service
known_limitations: A standard protocol does not establish the rights of an endpoint or record

name: Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes
rights_or_public_access_basis: Records explicitly marked PUBLIC; selected products require attribution
known_limitations: MAST also exposes EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS metadata and some copyrighted collections; only PUBLIC rows may pass

name: NOIRLab Astro Data Archive
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only science-image files whose exact metadata row supplies a nonblank past release_date
known_limitations: All archive metadata are visible anonymously, including metadata for proprietary files; this adapter stores no unreleased row and downloads no bytes

name: Authorized local file import
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only public, open, or user-owned files explicitly selected by the user
known_limitations: The importer refuses restricted rights labels and does not watch directories automatically

name: Authorized observatory/TOM/SkyPortal webhook
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public, open, or user-owned payloads explicitly labelled by sender
known_limitations: Private instances remain disabled until the user confirms authorization

name: Private TOM Toolkit / SkyPortal / marshal instances
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only user-owned or explicitly authorized instance records
known_limitations: A working token does not establish storage or redistribution rights

name: ALeRCE
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts are world-public; broker-derived products retain provider attribution
known_limitations: Access and redistribution terms for specific enriched products must be verified per service

name: AMPEL
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts are world-public
known_limitations: No stable general end-user machine interface was verified for automatic configuration

name: ANTARES
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin and public ZTF broker outputs
known_limitations: User-submitted streams and annotations may have separate sharing expectations

name: Babamul
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts are world-public
known_limitations: Machine-interface and rate-limit contract not sufficiently documented for an automatic connector

name: Fink
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts are world-public, and Fink documents its LSST portal/API as real-time with no login
known_limitations: Only two audited public extragalactic tags and bounded public REST fields are ingested; reliability remains uncalibrated source context

name: Fink Rubin Positional Candidates
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts and Fink's no-login LSST REST output are world-public
known_limitations: Coordinate and first-detection proximity do not establish identity; candidates remain catalog context until explicitly reviewed

name: IAU Transient Name Server
rights_or_public_access_basis: Hourly delta files explicitly contain public objects
known_limitations: Object, classification, photometry, and spectrum records can have separate proprietary periods; this adapter deliberately uses only public delta files

name: Lasair
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public ZTF broker object/light-curve output accessed through the user's account
known_limitations: The token is private; user annotations/watchlists are not ingested; negative difference flux is excluded from fitting

name: Pitt-Google
rights_or_public_access_basis: Rubin alerts are world-public
known_limitations: Cloud project data and derived products can have separate permissions

name: Rubin Science Platform Alert Retrieval Service
rights_or_public_access_basis: Alert packet contents are world-public; RSP service access is authenticated
known_limitations: Only exact broker-supplied diaSourceIds are queried. Packet measurements are not duplicated into CTAS while Fink supplies the normalized measurement history

name: 2MASS Point Source Catalog
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public 2MASS rows returned by the rights-allowlisted IRSA adapter.
known_limitations: Positional candidates are not automatic transient, counterpart, or host associations.

name: AllWISE Source Catalog
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public AllWISE rows returned by the rights-allowlisted IRSA adapter.
known_limitations: Positional candidates are not automatic transient, counterpart, or host associations.

name: Gaia Data Release 3
rights_or_public_access_basis: Exact allowlist to the public Gaia DR3 source catalog I/355/gaiadr3 served by ESA's official CDS partner
known_limitations: VizieR hosts many unrelated collections with distinct terms; this adapter cannot select them and does not retrieve Gaia DataLink products

name: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public NED API responses with required NED acknowledgment retained
known_limitations: Automated access is best-effort; requests must be single-threaded, at most one per second, and high-volume or longer-than-six-hour campaigns require provider coordination

name: NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive
rights_or_public_access_basis: Allowlisted public AllWISE Source Catalog and 2MASS Point Source Catalog rows
known_limitations: IRSA also hosts proprietary/exclusive-access and copyrighted holdings; this adapter cannot select any non-allowlisted collection and does not download image products

name: NED Positional Candidates
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public NED positional candidates returned by the rights-allowlisted bounded adapter.
known_limitations: Positional candidates are not automatic transient, counterpart, or host associations.

name: SIMBAD Astronomical Database
rights_or_public_access_basis: SIMBAD documents free access without registration under ODbL with acknowledgment and original-reference citation
known_limitations: SIMBAD is a heterogeneous literature meta-compilation, not a survey catalog; proximity never establishes target identity, host association, or a new detection

name: AMON IceCube–HAWC Coincidences
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only AMON stream 1 notices explicitly identifying the public IceCube–HAWC pair are accepted
known_limitations: The inputs are background-dominated subthreshold candidates; FAR guides follow-up but does not confirm a shared astrophysical source. Private AMON streams are refused

name: BOOM
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public GCN notices with source attribution and revision state.
known_limitations: CTAS subscribes through GCN; a named BOOM contract keeps mission coverage explicit.

name: CALET-GBM Public Flight Lightcurves
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes CALET-GBM flight-lightcurve notices and maintains a public archive
known_limitations: CALET-GBM has no source localization and NASA documents that approximately half of triggers are non-astrophysical; linked lightcurve bytes remain provider-hosted

name: CHIME/FRB
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public notices and source-attributed event metadata.
known_limitations: No direct CHIME client; retained public records arrive through GCN or event metadata.

name: DSA-110
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public GCN notices when the onboarding stream becomes operational.
known_limitations: GCN lists DSA-110 as onboarding; CTAS does not claim an active feed.

name: Einstein Probe
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public notices and source-attributed event metadata.
known_limitations: No direct Einstein Probe client; retained public records arrive through GCN or event metadata.

name: Fermi GBM and LAT Public Notices
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the eight audited operational Fermi notice types
known_limitations: Internal, team-only initial/diagnostic, pointing, and test topics are excluded; a high-energy trigger or localization is not an optical counterpart or a confirmed GRB classification

name: GCN Unified Mission Notices
rights_or_public_access_basis: Audited public Unified Schema notices, currently including Swift GUANO, Einstein Probe, MAXI, BOOM, and CHIME topic contracts
known_limitations: Mission archives can contain proprietary follow-up; this entry covers only public GCN products

name: GECAM Public Flight and Ground Notices
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the operational GECAM flight and ground notices
known_limitations: Trigger numbers at or above 100,000,000 are tests and are refused; broad source regions never drive canonical object matching or establish an optical counterpart

name: HAWC Very-High-Energy Burst Monitor
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the operational HAWC Burst Monitor stream and maintains a public notice archive
known_limitations: The broad statistical region cannot drive canonical object matching; p-value is not p_astro, and a trigger is not a confirmed GRB or common multimessenger source

name: INTEGRAL
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public archival GCN notices with original mission attribution.
known_limitations: Archival mission coverage is declared separately from an active live feed.

name: IceCube High-Energy Cascade Alerts
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only real-event rows from the explicitly public stream 26 archive and exact live topic are accepted
known_limitations: Cascade localizations are broad and signalness is model-dependent; neither establishes a counterpart or common astrophysical origin. Test examples are refused

name: IceCube Public Multimessenger Notices
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public Gold/Bronze track notices, explicitly named Classic archive files cited by GCN Circulars, and released LVK neutrino follow-up results
known_limitations: Internal collaboration products are out of scope; unnamed retractions and reused official names do not create events; p_astro and historical signalness are model-dependent and are not counterpart or common-origin probabilities

name: KM3NeT
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public notices when an official production interface becomes available.
known_limitations: GCN lists KM3NeT as onboarding; CTAS does not invent an operational endpoint.

name: Konus-Wind High-Energy Lightcurves
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes Konus-Wind notices and maintains a public lightcurve archive
known_limitations: The notice has no source position and can include non-astrophysical triggers or duplicate downlinks; provider-hosted product bytes remain linked

name: LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Public Alerts
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public LVK alerts distributed through GCN and public GraceDB products
known_limitations: Only explicitly public alert products may pass; private GraceDB groups and non-public event products are outside scope

name: Monitor of All-sky X-ray Image
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released public notices and source-attributed event metadata.
known_limitations: No direct MAXI client; retained public records arrive through GCN or event metadata.

name: NASA General Coordinates Network
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA describes notices and Circulars as publicly redistributed
known_limitations: No proprietary topic is configured; topic authorization does not itself change rights policy

name: SVOM Public GRB and Counterpart Notices
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the SVOM GRM, ECLAIRs, and MXT VOEvent topics
known_limitations: Only public VOEvent fields are retained; downstream mission archive rights are separate and parser support does not establish them

name: Super-Kamiokande Supernova Neutrino Alerts
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the Super-K JSON supernova-alert topic
known_limitations: Test and injection notices are refused; collaboration-internal products beyond the public notice are outside scope

name: SuperNova Early Warning System
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes SNEWS real and weekly test notices
known_limitations: Weekly TEST notices are validated as transport health but never admitted as astrophysical events; collaboration-internal detector products remain outside scope

name: Swift BAT to XRT/UVOT Follow-up
rights_or_public_access_basis: NASA GCN publicly redistributes the selected operational BAT/XRT/UVOT notices
known_limitations: Retired test, image, spectrum, light-curve, pointing, emergency, and spacecraft-control topics are excluded; provider-hosted product bytes are not copied

name: ASAS-SN Sky Patrol
rights_or_public_access_basis: ASAS-SN explicitly describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and supplies publication citations
known_limitations: The legacy form says to contact ASAS-SN for more than 100 light curves. The published V2 machine client uses unencrypted HTTP, while the linked HTTPS V2 host/repository are unavailable; automatic ingestion is withheld without implying that the public data are proprietary

known_limitations: CTAS retains the source label but has no standalone connector contract for this survey.

known_limitations: Partnership data products can have separate rights; use public products only

name: NASA Astrophysics Data System
rights_or_public_access_basis: Public bibliographic metadata returned by the ADS API
known_limitations: CTAS retains metadata and provider links only; it does not mirror article full text or infer reuse rights from discoverability

name: AAVSO International Database Photometry
rights_or_public_access_basis: AID observations are available for research and publication subject to AAVSO's current Data Usage Guidelines
known_limitations: The API is authenticated and every observer contribution, AUID, band, observation type, uncertainty, upper-limit flag, and required credit must remain source-native

name: ZTF Public Data-Release Light Curves at IRSA
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only the latest anonymous public data-release collection is queried
known_limitations: Release photometry may lag real time and is neither alert difference photometry nor forced photometry; coordinate association does not assert identity

name: NASA GCN Circulars
rights_or_public_access_basis: Released GCN Circular author text, metadata, corrections, and provider-hosted links are publicly distributed
known_limitations: Circular prose is retained as an attributed author report; values are not promoted to machine measurements without a mission-specific parser

name: TNS AstroNotes
rights_or_public_access_basis: Pages explicitly marked note-public with a release timestamp
known_limitations: Draft, private, ambiguous, authenticated-only, non-text, or unsupported table material is refused; only source-linked bounded public photometry text is parsed

name: AAVSO AVSpec Published Spectra
rights_or_public_access_basis: The anonymous search interface explicitly returns published observations; AAVSO permits publication use subject to its current Data Usage Guidelines
known_limitations: Observer credit, AAVSO acknowledgment/facility keyword, validation state, and current usage guidance must be retained; anonymous availability is verified per record

name: TNS Public Object Details and Spectra
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only objects explicitly marked public=1 and spectrum rows explicitly marked public=1
known_limitations: A credential can expose group-proprietary records. Object and spectrum public flags are mandatory; current photometry rows lack per-row visibility and are refused

name: WISeREP Public Spectra
rights_or_public_access_basis: Only anonymous public=yes export rows independently marked public=1
known_limitations: Private scripted access requires a personal API key; this adapter sends no credentials, refuses any row without public=1, and never treats repository membership as a new detection
